text:
simon: Quick heads up — planning to enable siren-7b-v3 in the model catalog today during the 13:30 PT change window. Canary targets: us-west-2 (10% traffic) and eu-west-1 (5% to start). Fallback ordering: siren-7b-v2 -> siren-7b-quant -> lite-siren. Please ack if you have objections or known blockers.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for siren-7b-v3 at 2024-06-15T13:30:00-07:00. Canary split: us-west-2=10%, eu-west-1=5%. Auto-rollback on error budget breach or 2x p99 latency increase.

tara: ack. will run the regression prompts and smoke tests on us-west canary once it lands.

maya: noted — I added a quick eval set (siren-safety-smoke) and a perf probe for p95/p99 tail. will post results.

cheng: quick question on pinning — do we want a hard pin to v2 for EU until telemetry is green? or soft preference?

simon: soft preference for now — let catalog routing fallback to v2 only on explicit latency/capacity triggers. but if eu shows any increased error rate we pin immediately.

maya: posting the perf check commands i'll run:
```bash
# p99 latency for model requests over the past 10m
curl -G 'https://telemetry.internal/api/prometheus' --data-urlencode 'query=histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{model="siren-7b-v3"}[10m])) by (le))'
```

deploy-bot: canary deployment logs:
```
[13:30:05] deploy: started canary siren-7b-v3 -> us-west-2(10%), eu-west-1(5%)
[13:30:22] nodes allocated: gw-serve-5, gw-serve-6
[13:31:10] model pulled and warmed on canary nodes
[13:31:50] traffic shifted: us-west-2=10%
[13:32:05] eu-west-1=5%
```

ops-bot: alarm: eu-west-1 request p99 spiked 2.4x vs baseline at 13:38:21 — alert id A-20240615-1321.

tara: seeing the same in the smoke tests — a subset of prompts with long context hit 2.1x p99. dropping canary running more checks now.

cheng: can we switch eu fallback to hard pin while we investigate? i can run a targeted drain.

simon: do the hard pin for EU. set fallback ordering so eu routes to siren-7b-v2 immediately. keep us-west at 10% until we confirm.

deploy-bot: executing pin command: `deploy pin --region eu-west-1 --model siren-7b-v2 --reason "eu p99 spike on v3 canary"`

deploy-bot: result: pin applied. eu-west-1 traffic now routing to siren-7b-v2. canary instances in eu will be drained with 5m grace.

maya: collecting logs and traces. initial flame graphs point to attention kernel hot path on long sequences — CPU bleed on the host side, not GPU. sending stackshots.

simon: good catch. if it's host-side we might need a quick runtime patch or slower rollout. postponing further EU attempts until we have a mitigation.

cheng: proposal: revert quant fallback priority in eu to avoid cross-quantization perf mismatch while we debug. keep quant as third choice.

tara: thumbs up from QA — we'll give the v3 canary a postmortem prompt set and re-run after the runtime fix.

maya: publishing a short release note snippet for the catalog changelog draft:
"siren-7b-v3: accuracy improvements on long-context summarization. Canary launched 2024-06-15. EU canary temporarily pinned back to siren-7b-v2 due to elevated tail latency; investigating host-side kernel interactions. No user-facing errors observed. Rollout paused for diagnostics."

simon: action items:
- maya: collect perf traces + upload to convai/trace-siren7b (ETA 60m)
- cheng: prepare a hotfix branch with a runtime guardrail (ETA 90m)
- tara: re-run regressions after hotfix in us-west canary (ETA after merge)
- ops: monitor eu p99 + error budget for 2h before restart

cheng: started a branch `runtime/guard/attn-fallback` and opened PR #8422. will add configurable fallback to older kernel path.

deploy-bot: note: current canary state: us-west-2=10% (active), eu-west-1=pinned->siren-7b-v2 (draining v3). auto-rollback disabled for eu (manual pin applied).

ops-bot: monitor window scheduled: 13:40-15:40 PT. alert email list: eng-releases@redwood.com, infra-oncall@redwood.com.

maya: uploading traces now -> https://internal/trace/convai/siren7b/20240615/abc123 (link).

tara: small note — customer-facing release notes should mention the temporary pause for EU; i can draft a 1-liner for marketing if approved.

simon: approved. tara go ahead. keep slack updated. we'll reconvene in 1h or sooner if new alerts. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

cheng: PR #8422 ready for review. adding test vector and toggle.

deploy-bot: follow-up when hotfix merges: run a canary re-enable job in EU with 2% initial traffic, 30m observation window, and immediate fallback to v2 on p99>1.5x.
